shortDescription: Adds an audit rule to files, folders, or registry keys

options.name: audit_flags
options.description: Defines whether to log on failure, success, or both. To log both define as comma separated list "Success, Failure".

options.name: inheritance_flags
options.description: Defines what objects inside of a folder or registry key will inherit the settings. If you are setting a rule on a file, this value has to be changed to C(none). For more information on the choices see MSDN PropagationFlags enumeration at U(https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/system.security.accesscontrol.inheritanceflags.aspx).

options.name: path
options.description: Path to the file, folder, or registry key. Registry paths should be in Powershell format, beginning with an abbreviation for the root such as, C(HKLM:\Software).

options.name: propagation_flags
options.description: Propagation flag on the audit rules. This value is ignored when the path type is a file. For more information on the choices see MSDN PropagationFlags enumeration at U(https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/system.security.accesscontrol.propagationflags.aspx).

options.name: rights
options.description: Comma separated list of the rights desired. Only required for adding a rule. If I(path) is a file or directory, rights can be any right under MSDN FileSystemRights U(https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/system.security.accesscontrol.filesystemrights.aspx). If I(path) is a registry key, rights can be any right under MSDN RegistryRights U(https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/system.security.accesscontrol.registryrights.aspx).

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the rule should be C(present) or C(absent). For absent, only I(path), I(user), and I(state) are required. Specifying C(absent) will remove all rules matching the defined I(user).

options.name: user
options.description: The user or group to adjust rules for.
